text:
sam: Acme Red Team PT intake arrived. They want staging access next Tue and a 48h retest window for critical findings. Uploaded artifacts to s3://redwood-pt/acme-incoming/1766501234.zip. Need quick decisions: ephemeral RBAC, KMS usage, audit retention, and IP allowlist. looping @maria @kevin @liz @jordan

maria: agree ephemeral role only. recommend a role that can only read objects under prefix `pt/acme/*` and only view CloudTrail LookupEvents. No S3 write. Use presigned reading-room URLs rather than direct console access.

kevin: yep. keep role lifetime short (1h) and require MFA. IAM condition on RequestTag pt-intake=acme. Will add an IAM policy snippet in a sec. Also want CloudTrail S3 data events enabled for the intake bucket so object-level KMSDecrypt events are recorded.

liz: audit retention plan: hot 90d, warm 1yr, archive 7yr if vendor requires long-term. All evidence manifests go into immutable S3 with object lock when possible. Ticketing: create a Jira epic PT-ACME-2026 and tag tickets `pen-test` `evidence-required`.

jordan: I can host a presigned reading-room behind internal proxy so we can also enforce SourceIp and TLS client certs. For KMS, create a customer CMK alias/pt_acme_assessor and grant decrypt/generateDataKey only to the assessor role. Avoid turning off rotation.

sam: Acme will run active scenarios including exploit scripts. They requested an IP allowlist. I propose short-lived firewall rules per-run and signed run manifests from the vendor listing IPs/time windows. Also propose retest SLAs: 48h for critical fixes, 5 business days for high/medium.

maria: short-lived allowlist is fine but must be captured in intake doc with exact CIDRs and owner. Vendors typically expect two retest attempts; offer two 2-business-day windows and document both.

kevin: for KMS telemetry, ensure CloudTrail logs `KMS:Decrypt` and `KMS:GenerateDataKey`, and set up a CloudWatch alarm for anomalous Decrypt rates. Add an IAM Condition restricting Decrypt to the reading-room proxy SourceIp.

liz: remediation flow: patch -> staged canary -> vendor retest -> production signoff. For evidence, require MD5+SHA256 checksums, signed manifest, and attach snapshots to Jira issues. Mirror artifacts to the immutable evidence bucket.

sam: chain-of-custody: prefer KMS Sign on manifest to attest ingest time and uploader. Anyone object?

jordan: no objections. I'll prepare the presigned reading-room and ensure proxy logs are forwarded to the evidence bucket. Also will add runbook sections: rollback steps, DB restore checklist, and KMS grant revocation steps. Page @ops-oncall for retest windows.

secbot: External assessor onboarding template: https://internal.tools/onboard-ephemeral — includes ephemeral IAM, presigned S3, and audit checklist.

kevin: IAM policy sketch (will PR):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-acme-assessor"},
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket","cloudtrail:LookupEvents","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt/acme-incoming/*","arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-pt-acme"],
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:RequestTag/pt-intake": "acme"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

maria: add explicit deny for s3:PutObject and any outbound egress except to whitelisted test targets. annotate intake with exfil limits and monitoring requirements.

liz: Jira details: PT-ACME-2026 epic, components: infra, platform, secops. Use subtask template for evidence uploads; fields: checksum_md5, checksum_sha256, manifest_signed (true/false), evidence_s3_path.

sam: action items: @kevin open IAM PR and CloudTrail config, @maria update intake doc and approve allowlist template, @jordan stand up reading-room and forward logs, @liz create Jira epic and subtask templates, I'll schedule a sync tomorrow 11am to confirm retest windows.

kevin: noted. I'll also add a CloudWatch metric filter `KMSDecryptSpike` and a playbook mapping for who gets paged on anomalies.

jordan: tagging ops-oncall now. please confirm someone will be available during retest windows.

ops-oncall: I'm available for the proposed windows. Please put exact run times in the ticket so we can schedule on-call coverage.

sam: closing notes: keep all PT creds ephemeral, never allow write or outbound network except stated test targets, store manifests with signed KMS attest when possible, mirror artifacts to immutable archive, and capture retest SLA in Jira. Thanks all — will share PR links and Jira once created. :thumbsup:
